No. 2398/57 – SUNDAY, AUGUST 25, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: BDD/LND/02/117-2019. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2019/S/193.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: An allotment of land-depicted in sheet 01, zone 02 of C. M. No. 810462 of 10.05.2024 made by the Senior Survey Superintendent, Galle situated in the Village of Walpita in the Grama Niladhari Division of 206, Walpita North, in the Divisional Secretary's division of Baddegama, District of Galle, Southern Province and the description of the allotment of land are as follows :- Lot No. 01 Name of the land : Olimpaswatta; Description : Home garden, 02 permanent buildings, a water tank; Claimant:

Government; Original Claimant: Land Reforms Commission; Extent: 0. 0400 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Baddegama on the 14 th day of October 2024 at 10.00 a.m, and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 07th day of October 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation and the details of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details or the computation of such amount. M.M.M.SHARFAS, Divisonal Secretary, Buddegama. Divsional Secretariat Baddegama, 21st August, 2024 EOG 08-0286

The General Public is hereby informend that the notice under Section 07 of the Land Acquisition Act which was published in the Gazette Extra Ordinary No. 2375/02 and dated 11.03.2024 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka will be amended as follows. Acquisition of land to create a water reserve and a canal in the abandon paddy lands located between Horana - Colombo bus route at Mampe North, Piliyandala and Piliyandala - Maharagama under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Enviroment Improvement Project. It should be corrected as Sheet No. 24, Block No. 10 of the Cadastral Map No. 521202 situated in the village called Mampe in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 574/A of Mampe North in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of the Western province.
